rationale: MMM is printing at 99.9% of today's range with price essentially at the session high ($170.80), having already surged ~5.4% from the open on 5.87x relative volume — a massive gap-and-run move with no news catalyst visible. Entering long here means chasing an extended move at the high with no pullback or consolidation structure to define a tight stop, while a short against a strong momentum thrust with this much buying pressure is equally dangerous. The risk/reward on either side is unfavorable at this moment; the prudent action is to wait for a defined structure to emerge.
